patient_context: Teenage patient with persistent joint pain following an initial diagnostic workup that did not resolve the differential.
diagnosis_norm: Undifferentiated musculoskeletal joint pain, diagnosis pending specialist evaluation.
payer_rationale: The plan stated an in-network orthopedist with equivalent qualifications was available and out-of-network referral criteria were not met.

evidence_cited.text: Plan's out-of-network referral policy requiring exhaustion of in-network options.

patient_context: An infant with a metabolic disorder requiring ongoing specialty pharmacologic management.
diagnosis_norm: Pediatric metabolic disorder requiring enzyme-targeted therapy.
treatment_requested: A specialty medication not previously trialed by the patient.
payer_rationale: The plan found the submitted records did not document a trial of standard first-line therapy before requesting the specialty agent.

patient_context: An adolescent male with a behavioral health diagnosis referred for a specialist evaluation outside the plan's network.
payer_rationale: The plan asserted comparable in-network behavioral health specialists were available within a reasonable travel distance.

evidence_cited.text: Plan network directory listing in-network behavioral health specialists.

patient_context: A young child with an oncology diagnosis requiring home-based supportive equipment during treatment.
diagnosis_norm: Pediatric oncologic diagnosis under active treatment.
treatment_requested: Durable medical equipment for home use.
payer_rationale: The plan's reviewing physician stated the equipment request lacked a treating physician's order documenting functional need at home.

evidence_cited.text: Treating oncologist's home-care recommendation letter (undated per the plan's review).

patient_context: A middle-aged patient recovering from a documented soft-tissue injury, requesting an extended course of home-based physical therapy.
diagnosis_norm: Soft-tissue injury with ongoing functional impairment.
treatment_requested: An extended, home-based physical therapy program using an investigational modality.
payer_rationale: The plan characterized the requested modality as investigational, citing insufficient published outcomes data for this injury type.

evidence_cited.text: Device used in the therapy program is FDA-cleared for a different indication only.
One ongoing Phase II trial evaluating the modality for this injury type, results not yet published.

patient_context: A young child presenting with acute dental pain requiring urgent evaluation.
diagnosis_norm: Acute dental infection with facial swelling.
treatment_requested: Urgent same-day dental procedure under the plan's urgent care benefit.
payer_rationale: The plan determined the presentation did not meet its urgent care severity criteria and directed the family to a routine dental appointment.

evidence_cited.text: Triage intake note describing swelling without fever or airway involvement.

patient_context: A teenage patient described as a high-risk candidate requiring inpatient admission for a digestive-system condition.
payer_rationale: The plan determined the clinical presentation could be managed in an outpatient or observation setting rather than full inpatient admission.

evidence_cited.text: Plan's inpatient admission criteria for digestive-system conditions.

patient_context: A young child referred for an investigational dental therapy after standard options were exhausted.
diagnosis_norm: Dental condition unresponsive to standard treatment.
payer_rationale: The plan classified the therapy as investigational, citing the absence of FDA clearance for pediatric dental use.

evidence_cited.text: Therapy not FDA-cleared for pediatric dental indications at time of request.

patient_context: An infant with a complex infectious-disease diagnosis referred to an out-of-network specialist for an investigational treatment consultation.
diagnosis_norm: Congenital infectious-disease diagnosis with ocular involvement.
treatment_requested: An out-of-network specialist consultation to evaluate an investigational treatment.
payer_rationale: The plan stated the consultation was itself for evaluating a treatment it considers investigational, and declined authorization pending its own review.

evidence_cited.text: Single case-series publication describing the investigational treatment in a related condition.

patient_context: An adult experiencing acute abdominal pain following a documented injury, presenting for urgent evaluation.
diagnosis_norm: Acute abdominal injury with suspected internal complication.
treatment_requested: Urgent diagnostic imaging and same-day GI specialist evaluation.
payer_rationale: The plan found the documented vital signs did not meet its criteria for expedited review and processed the request on a standard timeline instead.

evidence_cited.text: Requesting physician cited an unrelated clinical trial protocol for imaging frequency.

patient_context: An adult with an acute foot injury requesting urgent out-of-network podiatric specialist care.
diagnosis_norm: Acute foot injury with suspected fracture.
treatment_requested: An urgent out-of-network podiatric specialist consultation.
payer_rationale: The plan maintained an in-network podiatrist could see the patient within its urgent-care access-to-care window.

evidence_cited.text: In-network podiatrist's availability confirmation submitted by the plan.

patient_context: An older adult with a chronic temporomandibular condition requesting an elective surgical procedure using a newer technique.
treatment_requested: An elective surgical procedure using a novel technique for the chronic condition.
payer_rationale: The plan classified the specific surgical technique as investigational relative to its covered, established alternatives.

evidence_cited.text: One small retrospective study of the technique, not yet replicated.
